mapper.select: SELECT ms.MATERIAL_CODE as beadCode, IFNULL(SUM(ms.PLAN_SURPLUS_QTY), 0) as monthRemainQty, IFNULL(SUM(ppf.TOTAL_QTY), 0) as monthFinishQty FROM t_mdm_month_surplus ms INNER JOIN t_mp_month_plan_prod_final ppf ON ms.MATERIAL_CODE = ppf.MATERIAL_CODE AND ms.YEAR = ppf.YEAR AND ms.MONTH = ppf.MONTH AND ppf.DEL_FLAG = '0' WHERE ms.IS_DELETE = 0 AND ms.YEAR = #{year} AND ms.MONTH = #{month} GROUP BY ms.MATERIAL_CODE
